newsitem.title: INDIA: Quake hits north India, no damage reported.
newsitem.headline: Quake hits north India, no damage reported.

text.p: An earthquake of moderate intensity hit the northern Indian state of Himachal Pradesh late on Tuesday but there were no reports of injuries or damage, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
PTI said the earthquake, which was felt in the Kangra and Sundernagar areas in the state at 11.30 p.m (1800 GMT), measured 5.1 on the Richter scale.
Seismology officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
In May a powerful earthquake hit the central Indian city of Jabalpur, killing 38 people and leaving thousands homeless.
